selection_process: Selection is through a walk-in interview. However
if a large number of candidates turn up
a screening test comprising multiple-choice objective questions may be conducted to shortlist candidates for the interview. Shortlisted candidates will be interviewed by the Selection Committee

and a panel of recommended candidates will be formed based on interview performance. This panel will be utilised as and when requirements arise in the relevant field/project. Candidates have the option to interact with the committee in Hindi or English. If a large number of candidates attend
the interview may continue into the next day.
how_to_apply: There is no online application for this recruitment. Eligible candidates must attend the walk-in interview in person on the date allotted to their area of interest.
Check the eligibility criteria for the relevant post and area carefully before proceeding.
Download the application form in advance from www.nbri.res.in, or collect it at the venue on the day of the interview.
Reach the venue - K. N. Kaul Block, CSIR-NBRI, Rana Pratap Marg, Lucknow - 226001 - at least one hour before the scheduled time (11:00 AM) on the date applicable to the chosen area.
Carry one latest photograph, original documents, self-attested copies of all certificates from matriculation onwards, date of birth proof, and experience certificates.
Note that tentative mark sheets/certificates and "result awaited" documents will not be accepted.
Appear for document verification, followed by a screening test (if applicable) and/or the interview.

Only candidates who strictly fulfil the eligibility criteria and hold the required degree/mark sheet in the prescribed subjects should attend the walk-in interview. No interim queries will be entertained by CSIR-NBRI regarding this recruitment.

content_sections.text: The CSIR NBRI Recruitment 2026 walk-in interviews are scheduled area-wise between 8 and 11 September 2026 at CSIR-NBRI, Lucknow. Candidates are advised to be present at the venue one hour before the scheduled time for document verification. Venue: K. N. Kaul Block, CSIR-NBRI, Rana Pratap Marg, Lucknow - 226001. The exact application start date and last date to submit a form online are not specified in the notification, since candidates apply in person on the day of the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: CSIR NBRI Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview. However, if a large number of candidates turn up, a screening test comprising multiple-choice objective questions may be conducted to shortlist candidates for the interview. Shortlisted candidates will be interviewed by the Selection Committee, and a panel of recommended candidates will be formed based on interview performance. This panel will be utilised as and when requirements arise in the relevant field/project. Candidates have the option to interact with the committee in Hindi or English. If a large number of candidates attend, the interview may continue into the next day.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR NBRI Recruitment 2026 (Walk-in Interview Process)
content_sections.text: There is no online application for this recruitment. Eligible candidates must attend the walk-in interview in person on the date allotted to their area of interest. Check the eligibility criteria for the relevant post and area carefully before proceeding. Download the application form in advance from www.nbri.res.in, or collect it at the venue on the day of the interview. Reach the venue - K. N. Kaul Block, CSIR-NBRI, Rana Pratap Marg, Lucknow - 226001 - at least one hour before the scheduled time (11:00 AM) on the date applicable to the chosen area. Carry one latest photograph, original documents, self-attested copies of all certificates from matriculation onwards, date of birth proof, and experience certificates. Note that tentative mark sheets/certificates and "result awaited" documents will not be accepted. Appear for document verification, followed by a screening test (if applicable) and/or the interview. Only candidates who strictly fulfil the eligibility criteria and hold the required degree/mark sheet in the prescribed subjects should attend the walk-in interview. No interim queries will be entertained by CSIR-NBRI regarding this recruitment.

faq.question: Q1. What is CSIR NBRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by CSIR-National Botanical Research Institute, Lucknow (Advt No. 08/Project/2026) to fill temporary posts of Project Associate, Senior-PAT, Project Scientist-II, Young Professional and Project Assistant under sponsored research projects, through walk-in interviews.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CSIR NBRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 18 vacancies in total across Area-I (Molecular Biology and Biotechnology), Area-II (Pharmacognosy, Phytochemistry and Product Development), Area-III (Plant Ecology & Environmental Technologies) and Area-IV (Botanical Garden, Plants Conservation & Agrotechnologies).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CSIR NBRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no online last date since this is a walk-in interview. Interviews are held area-wise from 8 to 11 September 2026 at the CSIR-NBRI campus in Lucknow.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for CSIR NBRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification depends on the specific post and project, ranging from B.Sc./Diploma for Project Assistant-II to M.Sc./Integrated M.Sc./B.Tech for Project Associate posts, and Ph.D./Masters in Engineering with relevant experience for Senior-PAT and Project Scientist-II posts. See the Eligibility section for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CSIR NBRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is mostly 35 years for Project Associate/Assistant posts and 40 years for Senior-PAT/Project Scientist-II posts, with 21–45 years for Young Professional-II. SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates get 5 years' relaxation, and OBC candidates get 3 years' relaxation.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for CSIR NBRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must attend the walk-in interview in person at the venue and date applicable to their area, carrying the application form and all required original and self-attested documents. See the How to Apply section for the full process.
